text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Trainer, did ya see me?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Thanks! My body's burnin' hot!<n>These G1 races
sure turn up the heat!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Good race, Taiki.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Hey, Suzuka! Same to you!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I might've won today, but you sure<n>gave me a run
for my money! Thanks<n>a lot, Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: No... I should be the one saying<n>thanks.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: What?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I came here to thank you.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
When we were running, your speed<n>struck me to
my core...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: It helped me realize something.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: So... thank you.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Umm, sure...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
If that's how ya feel, then I'm awful<n>glad I could
help!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
But I ain't goin' down next time<n>either! Where're
ya thinkin' of<n>heading next?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Actually... I'm going to Hong Kong.<n>There's
something I don't want to<n>lose sight of.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Are you for real?! That's some grit<n>you've got!
You're somethin' else,<n>Suzuka!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
That means I won't see you for a<n>while. What are
your plans, Taiki?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hm... I'm gonna keep running in more<n>and more
races. I wanna see how<n>fast I can go!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Next up is the Yasuda Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: With that, the Mile Championship<n>draws to a close.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: The very limits of speed...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I'll get there one day, no matter what!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I just got off the phone with my folks!<n>They were
thrilled to pieces at the<n>good news!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: But the real surprise is still to come!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: When I become Umamusume of theYear, they'll be in for even more of atreat!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
How 'bout it, Trainer? You think I did<n>well enough to
be Umamusume of the<n>Year?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I think she's done all she can<n>possibly do as a
sprinter.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
But there's no denying that there are<n>other
Umamusume who have done<n>exceptionally well this
past year...
choice_data_list: Let's wait for the announcement in January.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Ooh, I don't think I can handle the<n>suspense!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
But training's sure to take my mind<n>off things! If I
just keep movin',<n>January'll be here quick as a
wink!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
All right! I've got more running to do<n>till I'm
Umamusume of the Year!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
We continue training diligently for the<n>upcoming
Yasuda Kinen, awaiting the<n>announcement of the
next<n>Umamusume of the Year...
